Appearance Area is a unit for managing appearance variability to color coordinate overall product appearance. Clr0AppearanceArea is used to divide the appearance area into designators. Clr0AppearanceArea collects and maintains the appearance designators within that appearance area.

TcProperty.description: A runtime reference property which captures immediate parent node of type Clr0AppearanceAreaBreakdown in appearance breakdown hierarchy.

TcStandardType.description: Clr0AppearanceAreaBreakdown is used to build a hierarchy of Appearance Areas. With Clr0AppearanceAreaBreakdown type user can breakdown the large appearance area into manageable chunks of appearance areas. Objects of this type can have Clr0AppearanceArea or Clr0AppearanceAreaBreakdown objects.

TcProperty.description: A runtime property which captures the immediate parent object of current node of type Clr0AppearanceAreaBreakdown.

OperationTemplate.description: This operation returns the color appearance data associated with a given set of input business objects. The targetObjects represents the lists of context business objects attached to the color appearances e.g. the color rules attached to the color appearances. The getColorAppearance operation returns the color appearances for the given set of context business objects.
OperationTemplate.name: Clr0::Soa::ColorAppearance::AppearanceManagement::getColorAppearance
OperationTemplate.returnDescription: This operation returns the list containing color appearance objects for each input business object. Any failure will be returned with clientId mapped to error message in the partial errors. Partial Errors are returned in the ServiceData.

OperationParameter.description: The list of targetObjects (context business objects).
OperationParameter.name: targetObjects

OperationTemplate.description: This operation attaches business object to Color Appearance(s). Input contains list of color appearances associated with the input context business objects. This operation first deletes all the existing color appearance data attached to input context business objects and then attaches color appearance data specified in input BusinessObjectColorAppearance list.
OperationTemplate.name: Clr0::Soa::ColorAppearance::AppearanceManagement::setColorAppearance
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
This operation returns nothing on successful execution. Any failure will be returned with clientId mapped to error message in the partial errors. Partial Errors are returned in the ServiceData. The following errors may be returned -
910001    Input object is not a type of a business object.
910002    You do not have sufficient privilege to set the color appearance(s) for the given set of business objects.
910003    Color appearances cannot be attached to as surface designator/color appearance not specified. Please provide surface designator/color appearance.
